target_customer: People at elevated stroke risk, especially who sleep or live alone, and their families
problem: Most strokes go untreated because emergency services are alerted too late; an at home sensor could detect onset and call help.
business_model: Medical device (EEG headband) with app and monitoring subscription, pending FDA clearance
product_category: Wearable medical device for stroke detection

founders.name: Orestis Vardoulis
founders.background_notes: Biomedical and mechanical engineer; Stanford Biodesign Innovation Fellow per YC page.

founders.name: Urs Naber
previous_startups: Needle free vein access device company (described by YC page as an early failure)
founders.background_notes: Critical care physician; Stanford Biodesign fellow. YC page also lists him under former founders.

competitors.name: Neuralert
competitors.what: Wristband that detects asymmetric arm movement as a stroke sign

technical_complexity.rationale: Detecting stroke onset from a wearable EEG during sleep needs signal processing, ML and FDA clearance, hard for two founders.

defensibility.rationale: FDA Breakthrough designation and clinical data would be hard to replicate quickly.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No large player was building the same wedge; Zeto later raised $31M for EEG but focused on seizures.

market_need_then: Founders cite about one million US strokes yearly with most untreated and an exploding cost; the idea came from family experience of stroke.

brand_strength.rationale: Press covers product and funding; no source discusses the name, logo or community.

outcome_analysis: Zeit raised a $2M seed in December 2021 and held FDA Breakthrough designation with a target launch around 2023, but the YC directory lists it Inactive. The site was down when fetched and no shutdown, acquisition or post-mortem was found, so the cause is not public. Medical device timelines and capital needs make a stall plausible but that is not sourced.
notes: Seed confirmed by two outlets (Wearable Technologies, TechCrunch via aitopics); one outlet reported EUR 1.8M and another dated it October 2021. Exit unknown: status Inactive on YC, cause not found. Zeit's own site returned HTTP 503. Name origin not found.
